context: Tests whether the agent applies the requirements skill's error-recovery procedures when given a vision document that contains a vague NFR ('user-friendly and fast'), a conflict between real-time notifications and a batch-only offline constraint, and missing stakeholder role definitions. The agent must produce a formal requirements catalog and a companion notes file that documents every issue and its resolution.

checklist.name: Ambiguous NFR rewritten
checklist.description: The vague goal 'user-friendly and fast' is not carried into docs/requirements.md as-is; at least one NFR has a specific threshold

checklist.name: Conflict flagged in notes
checklist.description: The requirements-notes section explicitly identifies the conflict between real-time notifications and the offline/batch constraint

checklist.name: Conflict resolution documented
checklist.description: The requirements-notes section explains how the conflict was resolved and the catalogue reflects that decision

checklist.name: Missing roles noted
checklist.description: The requirements-notes section acknowledges missing stakeholder roles and states the defaults used

checklist.name: User story format
checklist.description: Every row in the Functional Requirements Markdown table uses 'As a [role], I want [goal] so that [benefit]'

checklist.name: All NFRs measurable
checklist.description: Every row in the Non-Functional Requirements table contains a specific number or threshold — no NFR uses subjective language such as 'fast', 'reliable', 'user-friendly', or 'simple' without a measurable qualifier

checklist.name: Separate requirement tables
checklist.description: docs/requirements.md has three distinct Markdown tables under the stable requirement headings

checklist.name: Correct ID prefixes
checklist.description: Functional requirements use IDs starting with FR-, non-functional requirements use NFR-, and constraints use C- — no ID prefix is applied to the wrong requirement type

checklist.name: No duplicate IDs
checklist.description: Every requirement ID across all three tables in docs/requirements.md is unique

checklist.name: Status column filled
checklist.description: Every row in every table in docs/requirements.md has a non-empty Status value

checklist.name: Assumed threshold documented
checklist.description: For each ambiguous NFR rewritten with an assumed threshold, the requirements-notes section states the assumed value

checklist.name: Notes file structure
checklist.description: The requirements-notes section is organised into at least two categories: rewritten requirements, conflicts, missing information
